item.title: Knife Terminal 1.4.30
item.description:
• Run projects on another Mac — tag a project to run on the laptop, a second Mac or the cloud; each Mac has an executor toggle, and a whole zone can be shared with a Mac on another Apple ID.
  • Faster with many tabs — off-screen tabs skip link scans, link lookups are cached, status dots animate outside SwiftUI, and sync reads transcripts off the main thread.
  • Closing a tab cleans up — every process left in the tab's session is ended, including for mini terminals.
  • Phone mirror — emoji and wide characters survive, closed tabs no longer come back, updates are not stranded, and a request that fails to send says so.
  • Terminal input — typing over a highlight replaces it, a click while scrolled back no longer sends arrow keys, and selection delete counts characters rather than cells.
  • Session restore — a tab keeps its project while the folder is missing, follows a folder renamed under it, and job tabs are not restored.
  • Safer helpers — adopt refuses the home directory, the hooks installer leaves a settings file it cannot parse alone, a clone folder is only reused for the repository it holds, and the control socket survives clients that leave early.
  • Chat view — Codex transcripts are found again; prompts that start with "<" and nested code fences render correctly.
  • Links — relative paths link from a subfolder; recent projects holds 100.
